content.title: Event Hub - telemetry-raw : Incoming / Outgoing Messages

content.query:
let reader = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "service.ingestion"
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.layer"]) == "bronze-layer"
| where message matches regex @"\] R\|"
| extend durationStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[1])
| extend eventCountStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[2])
| extend durationUs = todouble(extract(@"^([0-9.]+)", 1, durationStr))
| extend eventCount = toint(replace_string(eventCountStr, "e", ""))
| where isnotnull(durationUs) and eventCount > 0
| summarize ReaderDurationMs = round(avg(durationUs / toreal(eventCount) / 1000), 2) by bin(timestamp, {Granularity});
let workers = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "service.ingestion"
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.layer"]) == "bronze-layer"
| where message matches regex @"\] W[0-9]+\|"
| extend durationStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[1])
| extend eventCountStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[2])
| extend durationUs = todouble(extract(@"^([0-9.]+)", 1, durationStr))
| extend eventCount = toint(replace_string(eventCountStr, "e", ""))
| where isnotnull(durationUs) and eventCount > 0
| summarize WorkerDurationMs = round(avg(durationUs / toreal(eventCount) / 1000), 2) by bin(timestamp, {Granularity});
reader
| join kind=fullouter workers on timestamp
| project timestamp = coalesce(timestamp, timestamp1), ReaderDurationMs, WorkerDurationMs
| sort by timestamp asc

content.query:
let reader_percs = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "service.ingestion"
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.layer"]) == "bronze-layer"
| where message matches regex @"\] R\|"
| extend durationStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[1])
| extend eventCountStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[2])
| extend durationUs = todouble(extract(@"^([0-9.]+)", 1, durationStr))
| extend eventCount = toint(replace_string(eventCountStr, "e", ""))
| where isnotnull(durationUs) and eventCount > 0
| extend durationPerEventMs = durationUs / toreal(eventCount) / 1000
| summarize rp25=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 25), 2), rp50=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 50), 2), rp75=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 75), 2)
| extend _k=1;
let worker_percs = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "service.ingestion"
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.layer"]) == "bronze-layer"
| where message matches regex @"\] W[0-9]+\|"
| extend durationStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[1])
| extend eventCountStr = tostring(split(message, "|")[2])
| extend durationUs = todouble(extract(@"^([0-9.]+)", 1, durationStr))
| extend eventCount = toint(replace_string(eventCountStr, "e", ""))
| where isnotnull(durationUs) and eventCount > 0
| extend durationPerEventMs = durationUs / toreal(eventCount) / 1000
| summarize wp25=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 25), 2), wp50=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 50), 2), wp75=round(percentile(durationPerEventMs, 75), 2)
| extend _k=1;
reader_percs
| join kind=inner worker_percs on _k
| extend Quartile = dynamic(["Q1", "Q2", "Q3"])
| extend Reader = pack_array(rp25, rp50, rp75)
| extend Worker = pack_array(wp25, wp50, wp75)
| mv-expand Quartile, Reader, Worker
| project Quartile=tostring(Quartile), ReaderDurationMs=round(todouble(Reader), 2), WorkerDurationMs=round(todouble(Worker), 2)
content.title: Reader & Worker - Duration Percentiles (ms)
